context_requirements: Expression of at least one BCL2-family anti-apoptotic protein (BCL2, BCL2L1/BCL-XL, BCL2L2/BCL-W, or MCL1)
Intact mitochondrial apoptosis machinery (BAX/BAK, caspase-9, APAF1)
Dependence on the targeted anti-apoptotic protein for survival (oncogene addiction or stress-induced priming)
TP53 status may modulate the transcriptional response but is not strictly required for direct apoptosis
falsifiers: No consistent change in apoptosis-related landmark genes (e.g., PMAIP1, BAX, CASP3) at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line
No decrease in proliferation-related genes (e.g., CCND1, PCNA, MCM3) at 24 h in any cell line
No difference in response between cell lines with high versus low expression of the targeted BCL2-family protein
Predominant upregulation of anti-apoptotic genes (e.g., BCL2, BCL2L1, MCL1) without any pro-apoptotic signature
